scope: Diagnostic full-amplitude timing with per-call trace/finite-check overhead; not an acceptance measurement. DP/QP FPE flags are sampled without reset; any set flag invalidates a cohort call, but a false flag is not an independent accuracy proof. Shared-host load is recorded; concurrent jobs can affect these timings.
